tailscale.hint: Join this appliance to your own Tailscale network (tailnet) so you can reach it — web UI, Lyrion Music Server, network shares, everything — from anywhere your tailnet reaches, e.g. to get at your music library away from home. This is not a public link: only devices on your own tailnet can reach it.
tailscale.unavailable: Tailscale isn't installed on this device yet.
tailscale.loginHint: Open this link on any device (even your phone) to approve this appliance from your own Tailscale account. Only needed the first time — the device stays authenticated after that.
tailscale.openLink: Open the link to approve this device

lyrion.hint: This device can run its own Lyrion Music Server, or use one that is already running on your network.
lyrion.internalHint: Lyrion Music Server runs on this device and manages your library.
lyrion.externalHint: Pick a Lyrion server already running on your network, or type its address.
lyrion.channelWarning: Nightly and development builds are pre-release: expect the occasional bug. Switch back to Release at any time.

display.switchToOnscreen: Turn the on-screen interface back on
display.confirmHeadless: The device screen will turn off immediately. Continue?
display.changeFailed: Could not change the display mode
display.resolutionHelp: On large screens the interface is drawn at full panel resolution, which keeps the graphics chip busy. Rendering it lower and letting the screen enlarge it makes everything much smoother, at the cost of some sharpness.
display.confirmResolution: The device's interface will close and reopen after a few seconds. Playback is not interrupted. Continue?
display.vuMeterHelp: The VU dial in the "now playing" screen updates live with the audio level. Turn it off to reduce GPU load. Useful here because it's reachable even on a headless unit, where nobody has the on-screen settings open.

updates.channelWarning: Development channel: you will receive prerelease, potentially unstable builds. Switch back to Production when you finish testing.
updates.keepPowered: The update continues on the device even if you close this page. Just keep it powered on.

companion.hint: Scan the QR code from the Osmium Sound Companion app to pair your phone.

backup.hint: Save the device's configuration, Lyrion preferences and playlists. Set a passphrase to also include credentials (Wi-Fi, SMB shares, this web-admin account) in an encrypted, restorable file — without one, only non-secret settings are saved.
backup.passphraseHint: Leave empty for a plain backup with no credentials. Set one to also save Wi-Fi networks, SMB passwords and this account, encrypted.
backup.restoreConfirm: Restore this backup? A safety copy of the current configuration is taken first.
backup.deleteConfirm: Delete this backup? This cannot be undone.
backup.scheduledHint: Runs unattended, so it never includes credentials — only device settings, sources and Lyrion preferences/playlists.

system.supportBundleHint: Downloads a zip with device logs and system information, useful for diagnosing an issue remotely.
system.factoryHint: Factory reset erases all settings (networks, sources, DSP, Bluetooth, pairings) and this account, then restarts into initial setup. Confirm with the admin password.
system.factoryConfirm: This erases ALL settings and this account, then restarts into setup. Continue?
system.factoryStarted: Factory reset started — the device will restart
